content:
Hello everyone,

I’m interested in exploring the real-world applications of Lean4 (or Lean more broadly) within the financial industry and other industrial sectors.

Are there any known projects, case studies, or production deployments where Lean has been used for things like formal verification of financial models, smart contracts, industrial control systems, or other relevant domains? I’d also be grateful for any pointers to past discussions, talks, or resources on this topic.

Thank you very much for sharing your insights!

Here's an article from Amazon Science, adapted from a talk by Leo de Moura (one of the creators of Lean), which introduces Lean & explains how Amazon uses it in several projects (with a security / cryptography direction).

Thank you so much for sharing this fantastic resource! An article from Amazon Science adapted from Leo de Moura’s talk is perfect for what I was looking for, and it’s incredibly helpful to get a concrete look at Lean’s production deployment in industrial settings. I really appreciate you taking the time to send this my way – if you happen to come across any other related case studies or resources down the line, I’d be extremely grateful for any further pointers you might be willing to share.
